rows.name: DUBH ARTACH ROCKS
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: Tower, 98 ft. high, on rock off Iona Sound. Light is red towards S. coast of Iona and Torranan Rocks, or to between E. ½ S. and N. by E. ¾ E.; the rest bright all round. Fog-bell 10 secs. in ev. 40 secs.

rows.name: ARDNAMURCHAN
rows.description: Stone tower, 118 ft. high, on the point. Shown between N.E. by E. ¾ E., and S.S.W. ½ W.

rows.name: Sound of Mull
rows.description: On Runa Gal Rock. Red lt. N. to seaward; green towards rocks; white towards Mull Sound.

rows.name: LISMORE
rows.description: White tower, 86 ft. high, on Musdile Island

rows.name: Loch Eil
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: On Corran Point. Light is red to E., between S.W. by W., and N.E. by E. ¾ E., and is br. to westward

rows.name: Oban
rows.description: A lantern on the pier for steamers

rows.name: Phladda Island
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: North end of Scarba Sound. The lt. is red northward, over Bogha Nuadh Rock, betw. N. by E. ¼ E. & N.N.E. ¾ E.; thence bright landward to S.S.W. ½ W.

rows.name: Crinan Canal
rows.description: One red light on East side

rows.name: Sgeir Maoile or Iron Rock
rows.character: One br. rev. lt. ½ min.
rows.description: Tower, 83 ft. high, on Sgeir Maoile or Skervuile, at S. entrance to Sound of Jura

rows.name: Rudha Mhail
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 113 ft. high, on N. pt. of Islay Island. Light is red to westward between N.N.E. ½ E. and W. by N. Bright in all other directions

rows.name: M'Arthur's Head
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 42 ft. high, on S. end of Islay Island. Light bright up Sound to N. ½ E.; thence red towards Jura to East. The rest bright.

rows.name: RHYNNS OF ISLAY
rows.description: White tower, 96 ft. high, on Oversay Island, off S.W. point of Islay

rows.name: Lochandail
rows.character: One bright, or red fix. lt.
rows.description: On Dun Point, N. of Port Charlotte. Light is bright to S., from S.W. by W. to S. by W.; thence red to E. ½ S.; then br. to N.E. by E. ½ E.

rows.name: Port Ellen
rows.description: Square tower, 60 ft. high, on Carraig Fadda Point, West entrance

rows.name: MULL OF CANTYRE
rows.description: S.W. headland of Cantyre

rows.name: SANDA ISLAND
rows.description: On the Ship Rock. Not seen to N. of S.E. by E. ¾ E.; kept in sight, clears Patterson Rk. Fog Horn, blast of 7 secs. every min.; best heard when southward of it. Elevated 150 [?]t.

rows.name: DAVAR ISLAND
rows.character: One br. rev. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: Stone tower, 65 ft. high, on East part

rows.name: Campbellton
rows.description: Red lt. on old pier-head, shows from S.S.E. to E.N.E.; green lt. on new pier-head, shows from S.S.E. to N.E. by E. ½ E.

rows.name: Ardrishaig
rows.description: A fixed white light on pier-head

rows.name: PLADDA ISLAND
rows.description: One 53 ft. above the other. On island, off S.E. pt. of Arran Island. Shown seaward from N.W. by W. to N.E. by E. ....Fog-trumpet, 5 secs. in every ½ minute
